newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: ALPINE SKIING-ALPHAND TAKES THIRD WIN ON STREIF.
newsitem.headline: ALPINE SKIING-ALPHAND TAKES THIRD WIN ON STREIF.

text.p: Frenchman Luc Alphand recorded his third World Cup victory on his favourite slope in Kitzbuehel, winning a two-run sprint downhill on Friday.
Alphand produced two near-perfect runs on a shortened version of the dreaded Streif piste for a winning aggregate of two minutes 12.55 seconds.
The 31-year-old captured his maiden victories here when two downhills were staged on the same day in 1995.
Friday's win marks Alphand's third victory of the season, after Val Gardena and Bormio, and the ninth in his career.

Austria's Werner Franz held on to his second place after the first leg with a total time of 2:12.95 while Switzerland's William Besse improved from a first descent eighth place for overall third in 2:13.13.
